title.text: A Child Lost to the Wilds

offer.text: A little one from our family wandered off and never came home. Search the forest where the children play — bring us any sign of them.

accept.text: Bless you. Hurry — the woods are no place for a child at night.

decline.text: Then we keep our own vigil, and hope.

in_progress.text: Any trace out in the forest?

ready.text: You searched the wood? Tell us what you found.

complete.text: At least someone cared enough to look. The family is in your debt.

failed.text: The trail's gone cold now. We may never know what became of them.
